segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned above the jar on the table, preparing to interact with it.
The robot arm descends and grasps the rubber band, lifting it from the table.
The robot arm moves the rubber band over the jar and begins to wrap it around the jar's neck.
The robot arm continues to adjust and tighten the rubber band around the jar, ensuring it is securely in place.
The robot arm releases the rubber band, completing the task of putting the rubber band around the jar.
